Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who we are: 
 Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.
 We are looking for: 
 We are seeking a skilled Full Stack Java Developer Developer (with React) to join our team.
 What you will do: 
Analyze, troubleshoot and correct application defects and incidents 
Develop new application features and enhancements in line with Business Owner and Product Owner priorities 
Optimize and refactor application code to improve performance, reliability and maintainability 
Participate in technical design, development, testing and validation activities 
Prepare deployment documentation and release instructions for each corrective patch 
Support deployment and production rollout activities when required 
Contribute to Agile/Kanban ceremonies and continuous improvement initiatives
 What you must have: 
Experienced Full Stack Developer with strong Java development expertise, React.js, solid database knowledge, and experience maintaining business-critical applications 
Strong ability to understand and analyze functional requirements and constraints 
Demonstrated capacity to work independently, with the level of autonomy expected for this role 
 What's in it for you: 
Extended compensation and benefits package
Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills
A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit
 We really welcome open-minded and committed people: 
Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things;
Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do;
Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.
